comment: With no clock patched the step length is ten to the power of minus the Rate knob, multiplied by the squared modulus of the Ikeda value and by a fifth of the sample rate (Strange.cpp:116). In Henon mode that modulus is held at one, so the rate is steady; in Ikeda mode it moves with the attractor. The two CV outputs are the raw attractor coordinates with the bias added and are not clamped, so their range depends on the attractor rather than on any setting.
